about: Every threshold the Flock and the record read, one file: `flock` holds the Flock's cells and `publish` the self-merge and probe cells publish.mjs reads. A threshold is chosen on the record's readings and never tuned live; each carries the n and the window it was read over, or says in terms that it was not read. No default flips under n = 5 runs / 20 tasks: a threshold read under that floor is an `experiment` with its `rollback` named. On 2026-11-14 the operator settled the Flock's experiments over 110 runs: the narrow pulls, the scope rule, the loose-ends task and the objection are the engine's only behaviour and carry no cell; the Jev step and peer-rewrite reads were cut.

self_merge.basis: 62 runs merged themselves; 2 merge requests were refused after a catch-up (a conflict, a red). Settled operator 2026-11-14, over n=110 Flock runs (2026-09-26..11-15, every tag in the evidence repository): the self-merge always runs, and a held run is the way to keep one open
self_merge.rollback: the way back is a checkout before 2026-11-14's settling (the cut modes' code left with it)

probe.unread: publish-as-probe (#835): deploy, live verify and rollback after the self-merge; pre-registered reading per release: publishes per run, verify reds, rollbacks and deploy seconds against timeout_seconds

exam.basis: the engine's limits before #1448; the catch-up reads the same cells, so a caught-up run is examined as strictly as the run
exam.rollback: none: catch-up's former 120 / 1800 let a fact red on time in the run pass at publish (#1448)

stall.basis: over 7 runs (247, 251–255, radio-station run-1, 2026-09-26..28) the longest wait for a rise in the green count was 2.0 min, and run-252 ran 229.7 min after its last rise; over 110 runs the stop never fired (0 stall:no-progress rows). Settled operator 2026-11-14, over n=110 Flock runs (2026-09-26..11-15, every tag in the evidence repository)
stall.rollback: the way back is a checkout before 2026-11-14's settling (the cut modes' code left with it); 0 turned the stop off there

main.basis: the run follows main as a peer from main's stored memory (weave_store.py): 45 runs read and stored the memory, 13 took in a moved main (11 ready; the 2 drafts were the lost-line read, since cut), none stopped following (0 main:off), and a file main and a builder each created is a conflict a builder closes (flock-baseline run-24, closed in 20 s, ready). Settled operator 2026-11-14, over n=110 Flock runs (2026-09-26..11-15, every tag in the evidence repository); the `memory` and `frozen` modes and `created = union` were cut
main.rollback: the way back is a checkout before 2026-11-14's settling (the cut modes' code left with it); deleting the target's ref refs/ultrapowers/weave/v1 forgets the memory
